ranking_rules: filters first; dense ranks all eligible docs, BM25 only docs with score > 0; RRF(k=60, depth=200); unranked docs never returned; ties broken by bank index
label_approximation: Relevance is approximated by the LEDGAR label: a hit is 'relevant' iff its label is accepted. This ignores whether the clause actually answers the question (e.g. the requested notice period) and penalises correct clauses filed under a near-synonym label not listed.
clause_to_clause_protocol: Queries: test clauses sampled per class (up to 10 per class -> 981 queries; classes with fewer test clauses contribute all of them). Bank: de-duplicated train split. A retrieved clause is relevant iff it has the same LEDGAR label as the query. Exact duplicates of the query (normalised text) are removed from the results before scoring. p@k has a fixed denominator k.
questions_protocol: 40 hand-written questions, fixed before any result was seen and unchanged since (so a re-run is a non-regression check, not an independent validation). Top-10 per mode. precision_at_10 divides by 10 (missing hits count as misses); precision_among_returned divides by the number of hits returned. duration_mention_rate = share of hits that MENTION the requested number of days, whatever its legal role: it does not validate a notice period.
